responsibilities: Collaborate with actuarial, risk, investment management, and finance colleagues to understand business needs and deliver practical solutions.
Design and maintain data models and structures for capital, risk and market data.
Build and operate data pipelines from source systems into our cloud data platform.
Create analysis‑ready, business‑friendly datasets and semantic models for reporting and dashboards.
Implement and maintain calculation logic for key capital and risk metrics.
Contribute to data quality controls, reconciliations and documentation.
Work with modern engineering practices (version control, code review, CI, structured environments) to enable safe and rapid change.
Support continuous improvement of the data platform and share knowledge within the team.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: You will enable reliable investor and regulatory reporting, support business steering through reliable KPIs
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour language dominates - 'trusted information', 'reliable investor and regulatory reporting', 'data quality controls, reconciliations and documentation' - against a single velocity mention ('safe and rapid change').
evidence.domain_risk: You will enable reliable investor and regulatory reporting, support business steering through reliable KPIs
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Insurance capital modelling with explicit regulatory and investor reporting means errors carry direct regulatory and financial-reporting consequence.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Zurich is enhancing its data platform to support capital modelling, risk analytics, and finance reporting.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A data platform already exists and is being enhanced, with a named sub-team (Capital and Risk Development) but no evidence of multiple specialised data sub-teams.
evidence.jd_authorship: Implement and maintain calculation logic for key capital and risk metrics.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Domain-specific bullets about capital and risk calculation logic sit alongside generic filler such as 'Support continuous improvement of the data platform and share knowledge within the team', with no named tools in the responsibilities themselves.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: provide trusted information to actuarial, risk, investment management and finance teams
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is finance and its adjacent control functions - actuarial, risk and investment management - serving investor and regulatory reporting.
evidence.autonomy_level: Contribute to data quality controls, reconciliations and documentation.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The verb set is delivery-oriented throughout ('Collaborate', 'Build and operate', 'Contribute to', 'Support') with no direction-setting or strategy ownership.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The JD never mentions AI, ML or AI tooling in any form, so no AI skill is expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Contribute to data quality controls, reconciliations and documentation.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality appears as a responsibility bullet with an action verb rather than as a tool name in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: data pipelines, data models and reporting layers that provide trusted information to actuarial, risk, investment management and finance teams
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust and regulatory reporting framing appears in the role summary itself - the fear is unreliable numbers reaching investors, regulators and business steering.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Zurich is enhancing its data platform to support capital modelling, risk analytics, and finance reporting.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The framing is enhancement and continuous improvement of an existing platform rather than building one from scratch.
evidence.language_gate: Proficient English, clear communication skills and a collaborative mindset
evidence.work_arrangement: Form: Hybrid - minimum 60% of time in the office
evidence.loss_aversion: Contribute to data quality controls, reconciliations and documentation - the control vocabulary (controls, reconciliations) frames the role around preventing incorrect capital and risk figures from reaching regulatory and investor reporting.
